newsitem.title: LATVIA: Olainfarm dominates Latvian bourse, price stable.
newsitem.headline: Olainfarm dominates Latvian bourse, price stable.

text.p: The Latvian bourse was dominated by secondary list newcomer Olainfarm on Tuesday and its price, seen by many as high, remained stable, dealers said.
Turnover was almost unchanged at 78,000 lats against 80,000 lats and the Rietumu index slipped 0.92 percent to 156.57.
Olainfarm, yesterday's secondary list newcomer, showed turnover of 49,000 lats, triple the official list total volume, at an unchanged 2.45 lats.
Dealers had predicted that Olainfarm would join the bourse at around 1.5/1.9 lats.

However, investment company Hansa Investments earlier sold a stake in the company for 2.50 lats a share. Dealers said the investment company may not want the price to fall. Hansa was not available to comment.
The company sold the shares before Olainfarm released uninspiring figures showing a first quarter loss.
"This is an okay share but the price could be lower in the short term," one dealer said.
"The big and round demand figure might be a sign of one player buying the shares," another added.
Official list stocks were stable to lower with Riga Shipyard and Staburadze most in demand.
Valmiera Glassfibre, a leading secondary list stock, added two santimes to 1.52 lats on volume of 6,000 lats and the Lode Brick, Mangali Shipyard were also in demand.
Lode traded 3,400 lats of shares and stayed put at 2.30 lats and Mangali was unchanged too at 1.17 lats, as it traded 2,600 lats.
